decisions.reason: The 140×100 resize and ESP32 edge placement apply to the main board. The message does not change the sensor-board dimensions, placement, connector alignment, or enclosure position.
A same-message MODIFY already completely records the required individual-JST architecture and prohibition on a consolidated fan-out connector.
The requested 140×100 outline and rearrangement concern the main board, not the power board; no power-board mechanical attribute is changed.
Retaining individual JST connectors does not alter the defined panel controls, their signals, or their connector mappings.
The source changes board dimensions, connector architecture, and ESP32 placement but does not change any GPIO assignment.
The board-layout decision does not change the monitoring IC, monitored rails, channel allocation, or monitor position.
The source does not alter the OR-ing method, power sources, diode requirement, or source-selection behavior.
Keeping the ESP32 at the board edge does not change the requirement to expose currently unused pins through through-holes or impose a new breakout-hole placement rule.
The source does not change the I2C resistor value, population policy, purpose, or topology.
The main-board mechanical and connector decision does not change the power-board DCDC1 voltage setpoint or compensation behavior.
The source does not change the buzzer type, prototype part, or accepted substitute.
The board resize and connector decision do not alter the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
